officialSourcesChecked.name: City of Spokane: Downriver Park River Access Area Now Open (2024-04-24)

researchCandidate.source: v1 research: AW 'Put In' coordinate (generic label); 63 m from OSM Spokane centerline; no OSM access feature

evidence.whyNotLevel1: CLOSURE-UNCERTAIN - not promoted. City of Spokane reopened Downriver Park (near TJ Meenach Dr) in April 2024 with a 'renovated non-motorized watercraft access area' (explicit), but the site closed again after a November 2024 hillside breach and the Spokane River Forum reports a May 2025 reopening 'for the summer season' (seasonal gate).
